## Core Service Capabilities
1. [Websites & Editorial Platforms](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities):
   - Decoupled architecture using Sanity Studio v3, Payload CMS 3.0, and Next.js App Router.
   - Core Web Vitals tuning, structured schema modeling, and global CDN delivery.
2. [SaaS MVPs & App Frontends](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities):
   - Fast sprint-based engineering delivering validated MVPs to paying users in weeks.
   - Authentication, SaaS-grade analytics dashboards, and billing integrations (Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Razorpay).
3. [CMS Migration & Decoupled Re-architecture](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities):
   - Complete zero-downtime migration from brittle monolithic setups (WordPress, Drupal, custom PHP) to modern API-first headless stacks.
4. [Ongoing Architecture Maintenance & Retainers](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities):
   - Scheduled security audits, dependency updates, and continuous performance tuning.

## Technical Comparisons: Headless vs Legacy Monolith
- [Architecture Comparator](https://reachorion.net/#architecture):
  - **Performance**: Headless provides ~180ms edge TTFB and <0.4s LCP vs Monolithic server-side PHP bottlenecks (>1,200ms).
  - **Security**: Headless completely isolates content repositories behind API boundaries with zero public database exposure vs Monolithic vulnerability to plugin exploits.
  - **Scalability**: Headless scales infinitely across global CDNs with zero compute spikes during traffic surges vs Monolithic server crashes under high concurrent load.
